title: Check HTTP Endpoint
description: Check an HTTP/HTTPS endpoint and report its response status.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

URL="${1:-https://example.com}"

STATUS=$(curl -L -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 "$URL")

echo "HTTP status for $URL: $STATUS"

if [[ "$STATUS" =~ ^2|^3 ]]; then
    echo "OK: Endpoint is responding."
else
    echo "ERROR: Endpoint returned $STATUS." >&2
    exit 1
fi
